questions.answer: Each I2C device must use the expected address.
questions.explanation:
Each I2C device must use the expected address.
Why: Consider the pin matrix, board-reserved pins, and driver API together. I2C may need pull-ups; SPI needs chip select; UART requires matching baud and signal levels.
